messages.text: Hi, the running shoes I got are too small. Can I get a refund?

I found the trail running shoes in order d06-o1, but the return records don’t show that they’ve been received. The shop can refund them only after they arrive back. If you’ve already sent them, tell me and I can ask a person to check; if you’ll send them later, please contact us once they’ve arrived. (refund-policy/v2/return)
